_note: Event Instructions (§8.5.5), dalla scheda del gioco fisico: cosa fa una Fazione NP su una carta Evento specifica. La maggior parte sono indicazioni su quale colonna usare per scegliere gli spazi, e finiscono nel Log perché siano leggibili. Le voci con `critical_if`, `performed_if` o `perform` sono invece calcolabili e le applica il motore: cambiano se l'Evento è Critico, se è considerato Performed, e quale delle due opzioni si gioca.

corporations.text: Use Exploit to select spaces to shift towards Active Support.

marsgov.text: Critical if any Satellites currently in Orbit, otherwise not effective.

red_dust.text: If MG is player, reduce MG Resources by 6. Otherwise, remove all Supply markers from Transit.
NP RD will not gain any Resources or increase Agitate Total.

marsgov.text: Use Remove or Replace to select one space with SpecOps and Hidden Rebels.

corporations.text: Use Remove or Replace to select one space with SpecOps and Hidden Rebels.

red_dust.text: Use Ambush to select one Labyrinth, place 2 RD Rebels there, then draw a Curiosity card for Ambush instructions.

marsgov.text: Use Remove to select a destination space, then Move Priorities treating Security as MG Troops and all spaces as adjacent.

corporations.text: Use Remove to select a destination space, then Move Priorities treating all spaces as adjacent.

red_dust.text: Use Shift Towards Active Opposition to select one space adjacent to a Maglev line, then do the same again to select a second space if necessary to determine a single Maglev line.

corporations.text: House using Place Population only at CORP Bases.

red_dust.text: Do not remove any Population markers from Displaced Population.

reclaimer.text: Remove all Population markers from Displaced Population.

marsgov.text: Use Shift Towards Active Support to select two Deserts with Opposition (if possible, otherwise select Neutral), then place Supply.

corporations.text: Use Exploit to select any two Deserts, then increase Profits.

Use Exploit to select spaces to shift towards Active Support.

red_dust.text: Use Remove or Replace to select a destination space with a CORP Base reachable from one origin space with the most moveable RD Rebels, then use Move Priorities to move Rebels there.

reclaimer.text: Use Remove or Replace to select a destination space with a CORP Base reachable from one origin space with the most moveable CR Rebels, then use Move Priorities to move Rebels (only) there.

marsgov.text: Add three Population markers to Displaced Population.

red_dust.text: Performed if 4+ Population markers in Displaced Population, otherwise not effective.

corporations.text: Select player Faction first, then CR.

corporations.text: Select Deserts with most Opposition, then use Remove or Replace.

reclaimer.text: Use Place Bases to select Unpopulated Deserts only.

reclaimer.text: Use Move Priorities and Travel Destination to select a destination with an enemy Base, then Attack there after moving.

corporations.text: Select a Desert using Remove or Replace, then use Move Priorities to move units there, treating all spaces as adjacent. Recon without moving any units, then Assault.
